export: Unchanged self and logbins rows; fixed32 alternate view omitted.

protocol.data: Same four ~2k-token separate excerpts used in adaptive-head-cutoff validation. Uniform99% whole-model pruned run, not head-specific cutoff schedule. 2062 query positions per text, including prefix/warmup/self; all336 heads.
protocol.selection: For each query/head, keep smallest descending-score prefix reaching99% attention mass, including crossing key, then renormalize. All earlier layers also trimmed; actual intervened Q/K/V propagated.
protocol.fraction: Pooled per-head fraction=sum retained keys / sum available causal keys across queries and texts. Mean overheads reproduces33.668255% aggregate. Per-query distributions show K/(query_position+1); these can differ from the pooled fraction.
protocol.relative_time: Age=query_position-key_position; self0, previous1. Plots use negative age, oldest left and query right. Full-range linear32-token bins; recent linear4-token bins. Selection probability at a distance divides by opportunities for that distance. Location share divides by all retained keys in that head. Attention mass uses pre-renormalization selected weights, averaged perquery; sums to at least99%.
protocol.validation: All four rerun next-token argmax sequences exactly match previous uniform99 runs; loss matches within1e-5, per-head count sums match relative-time histograms, weights sum to query count, aggregate retained fraction matches previous float32 tally within1e-6.
protocol.limits: Counts describe query-dependent selections; not permanent deletable history. Averaged over texts and queries; relative-time peaks can combine distinct patterns, including variable-distance prefix attention. These plots alone do not prove learned fixed-distance kernels.

distance_view.source: Same four ~2k-token uniform99% whole-model pruning runs as original retained-key report. All causal query positions, including prefix/warmup/self.
distance_view.x_axis: True log2 scale on positive distance=query_position-key_position. Older past on left, recent on right. Self distance0 shown separately with same color scale.
distance_view.main_view: Preserve existing32-token bins, except split original ages0–31 into self0 and ages1–31. Other intervals unchanged. Axis change alone does not resolve within-bin detail.
distance_view.alternative_view: Mass reaggregated in integer-age bins1,2,3–4,5–8,9–16,etc. Widths grow with distance; last bin1025–2061. Color encodes total mass per bin, not per-token density; variable-width bins contain different numbers of token positions.
distance_view.mass: Native selected weights before final restricted-softmax renormalization; averaged over all query positions/texts. Same0–100% linear color scale for both views and self.
distance_view.checks: For all336 heads, nonself bins partition ages1..2061 exactly; sum of distance-bin mass and self agrees with original total retained mass within1e-10 percentage points.
